response.justification: Bogdan is a seasoned generalist engineer (15+ years, staff-level titles, strong TypeScript/Node, distributed and low-latency systems, open-source founder) with recent, relevant exposure to MCP code generators and agentic workflow tooling at re:cinq. However, the core requirement — 8+ years building and shipping production-grade AI solutions — is not met; AI work appears to span roughly the last year. The resume shows no Python, no vector databases or RAG architectures, no LLM evaluation/observability pipelines, and only light cloud experience (AWS CDK), plus no evidence of customer-facing discovery or consulting leadership. Strong engineering foundation and teaching/mentoring track record make him worth a conversation if the team will invest in GenAI ramp-up, but he is a stretch for a Staff FDE GenAI hire.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production software across web, backend, mobile and embedded, with staff-level scope
Hands-on MCP server/code-generation and agentic workflow tooling experience (rare and directly relevant)
Proven mentoring, workshops and conference talks — supports the technical-leadership and enablement side of the role
concerns: No demonstrated RAG, vector database, LLM evaluation or multi-agent framework experience
AI/GenAI experience ~1 year versus the required 8 years of production AI delivery
Python absent from skills; limited cloud-native AI architecture and no customer-facing/consulting evidence

key_factors.factor: Missing RAG, vector DB, and LLM evaluation expertise
Deep senior engineering breadth plus MCP/agent tooling exposure
